title: Climate projections for Australia
notes: Projections based on up to 40 global climate models; 21 variables; 20-year periods centred on 2030, 2050, 2070 and 2090.

title: Australian Flood Risk Information Portal
notes: National catalogue of flood studies/maps contributed up to 2018; useful for coverage and historical studies, not current complete flood hazard.

title: Australian Rainfall and Runoff
notes: National design-flood guidance and data; current edition supports climate-change-informed flood estimation.

title: DEA Water Observations
notes: Historical surface-water observations useful for floodplain/wetness recurrence; not a substitute for design flood studies.

title: DEA Fuel Moisture Content
notes: Vegetation dryness product relevant to fire-risk analysis and changing climate conditions; requires integration with fire-weather/fuel/topography layers.
